name: claude-code-redact
description: A Claude Code mod that redacts secrets and PII before Claude reads them and before the transcript stores them.

plugins.name: redact
plugins.description: Redacts secrets and PII from every row Claude Code stores: prompts, file reads, shell output, MCP results, attachments. Placeholders are restored only inside Edit and Write arguments, so file edits still work. Reach L0: no network, no processes, no files.
